Class GUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.graphic.GUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
UI
public class GUI extends Object implements UI
The GUI class represents the graphical user interface for the application. This class extends the UI class and is responsible for managing and displaying various game scenes and events
